title: Cupcake and Sprig Help the Moth
markdown:
The moon began to climb, slow and soft. It made the leaves on the old oak tree look silvery. It was like a soft sleepy whisper over the world. Cupcake the cat was soft, like warm milk. She was settling down on her favourite soft spot. It felt like a cloud made just for napping. Her purr rumbled low and steady. It was a warm sleepy song that went all through her soft body, like a tiny happy engine winding down for the night.

Nearby, Sprig the squirrel was busy. His tail was like a soft question mark. He liked to put his little stones in just the right place. He made sure each one sat just so, in its perfect quiet spot.

Then a tiny soft flutter came. It was like a tiny leaf falling. A little moth, no bigger than a daisy petal. Its wings were soft, like a candle flame. It drifted softly, softly on the soft wind. The little moth looked all around. Its tiny feelers twitched. It looked like it didn’t know where to go. The world was getting big and shadowy.

“Oh, my,” whispered Cupcake. Her green eyes opened wide, soft with worry. “Our little friend looks a little lost. He needs a helping paw.”

Sprig twitched his nose. His bright eyes watched the little moth’s slow flight. “He does, Cupcake,” he chirped softly. His voice was like the rustle of leaves. “He needs a friendly light to show him where to rest. The night is lovely and peaceful. Little moths like to find their special place.”

And so Cupcake walked very softly, like on moonlight. Her purr was a warm soft sound. It helped the little moth feel safe. Sprig scampered beside her. His tail was held straight, like a little furry arrow showing the way. They walked through the moonlit garden. The sleepy flowers were folding their soft petals, tucking themselves in for the night. The air smelled sweet and cool, like wet earth and sleepy flowers.

“Look,” murmured Sprig. He pointed with a tiny careful paw. A warm golden glow peeked through the rose bushes. It was a light like a gentle hug, steady and inviting.

The little moth fluttered a little closer. It liked the steady soft light. Its wings moved more steadily. It was heading towards the light, a tiny spark guiding it home.

The moth found the warm porch light. It settled softly on the warm glass. Its tiny legs held on tight. Cupcake let out a long happy sigh. She felt so happy and peaceful. Her purr grew even softer, like a sleepy whisper, a lullaby just for her and Sprig.

Sprig nestled down beside her. His bushy tail curled around him like a warm cozy blanket. He was snug and safe. The night was peaceful. The world was perfectly still and quiet. Everything felt just right, like a perfectly placed puzzle piece.

And so, as the moonbeams softly kissed the sleepy flowers, Cupcake and Sprig, feeling safe and warm, curled up for slumber. The moth’s wings were still on the warm glass, a tiny candle-flame at rest. Soon even the littlest friend had found its way to a cozy rest.
